title: Wolves at the Birches | Nat 20 Pixels C1E4
description:
Night falls in Thornpike Woods, and the goblin trail splits three ways in the dark.
Ilsevel has a spell for exactly this. She has just never cast it before.

Episode 4 of a daily pixel-art D&D 5e story. Brannoc, Ilsevel, Tamsin and Oriel follow the goblins into the forest at night. A ritual by a dead stump, a new and very opinionated companion, and something circling the birch clearing. Every check, attack and spell is decided by real, seeded dice shown on screen: no rerolls, no fudging.

New episode every weekday. Characters, quotes and every roll are on the wiki.

short.title: The wolf rolls a natural 20 | Nat 20 Pixels
short.description: Three starving wolves in a birch clearing at night. One of them rolls a natural 20, and Tamsin never sees it coming.
